title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.14959v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. translated_abstract: 公式化Alpha挖掘旨在从庞大且充满噪声的搜索空间中发现能够捕捉预测性市场信号的可执行表达式。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法主要依赖提示工程、迭代搜索或种子因子进化，而通过策略学习直接构造因子的路径较少被探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AlphaRLM，一个强化学习框架，用于训练大语言模型在无需输入因子表达式的情况下，直接从金融文献中构造可执行的符号化因子。AlphaRLM引入了文献引导算子组装机制，将因子构造建立在文献衍生的思想与可执行算子之上，为探索提供语义先验。它还通过可执行有效性奖励和分组收益分离奖励（后者能够捕捉因子各分位数间的非单调结构）将生成策略与市场反馈对齐。在沪深300、中证1000和标普500上的大量实验表明，AlphaRLM……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: AlphaRLM是一个强化学习框架，通过文献引导算子组装（LEGO）提供语义先验，并借助可执行有效性与分组收益分离等奖励将生成策略与市场反馈对齐，从而训练大语言模型直接从金融文献中构造可执行的符号化Alpha因子。
en_tdlr: AlphaRLM is a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to directly construct executable symbolic alpha factors from financial literature, leveraging Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO) for semantic priors and executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards to align the generation policy with market feedback.
